stem: A shift begins with an active electrical hazard and a routine KPI worksheet due soon. What should Technician II prioritize first?
choices: Apply the required stop or safety escalation before routine analytical work.
Finish the KPI worksheet first because it has a deadline.
Continue work around the hazard until a supervisor arrives.
Ignore the hazard if crop symptoms are also present.
rationale: Immediate serious hazards outrank routine work; the integrated lab evaluates whether the candidate protects safety before optimization or paperwork.
